basic_info.description: Welcome to 1563 43rd Ave! This beautifully renovated home has been thoughtfully redesigned with high-end finishes, an open layout, and luxurious amenities. 3 ensuites, 3 offices / bonus rooms, and 4 and half-bathroom. The main level opens to a light-filled living room with custom built-in bookshelves and electric fireplace ideal for gatherings. Chef kitchen equipped with Thermador appliances, 2 primary ensuite, and bonus room ideally used as office or baby room. Downstairs, discover a spacious family room with wetbar, French doors opening to deck & garden, 2 bonus rooms to be used as private office or guest room, and a third primary suite with sliding door to the rear yard creating a lovely indoor-outdoor flow. Enjoy a large luxury laundry room with ample storage, a one-car garage, and additional driveway parking. This house has enough space for you, your family, friends and extended family. Do not miss this GEM!
